question: Should `findOpenAIStrictSchemaViolations` become a supported public `provider-tools` Plugin SDK export, or should this refactor keep it internal to the AI/provider implementation?
rationale: A new Plugin SDK export is a compatibility commitment, and the PR description explicitly says that public SDK exports are unchanged.

options.title: Keep the helper internal

options.title: Adopt it as SDK API
options.body: Keep the export only with explicit maintainer approval, API documentation, and focused external-consumer compatibility coverage.
